name: CryptoNewAccountBurst
label: REPLAY
scenario_text: New accounts (0-7 days old) make small crypto purchases ($50-$300) at business hours with moderately elevated velocity (3-10/h). 60% use new devices, 20% have geo mismatches. Evasion: 15% blend toward legitimate behaviour.

attack_spec.name: CryptoNewAccountBurst
attack_spec.description: Small crypto purchases from brand-new accounts during business hours.

proposed_rule.rationale: Targets crypto transactions on accounts younger than one year; legitimate customers in this segment may also be affected.
